title: Unemployment Benefit Claims — Extended Benefits Maximum Benefit Amount from the Parent Claim
content:
The maximum benefit amount of an Extended Benefits (EB) claim of Unemployment Benefit Claims is determined from the parent claim named on it.

## Determination

1. **Wage equivalent of the employment test.** The claimant shows the minimum weeks of full-time base-period employment through their wage equivalent: the parent claim's base-period wages must be at least 40 times the parent's weekly benefit amount (the wage-weeks test). An Extended Benefits claim whose parent wages fall short of that is determined with a maximum benefit amount of zero.
2. **Parent entitlement measure.** The regular benefits paid on the parent claim: every payment issued on it less every cancelled payment.
3. **Lesser amount.** The lesser of one half (0.5, the Extended Benefits fraction) of the parent entitlement measure and 13 (the Extended Benefits weeks) times the parent's weekly benefit amount plus dependency allowance, rounded down to the whole dollar.
4. **Training addition.** The training weeks added times the value of a training week, rounded down to the whole dollar. It is added to the rounded lesser amount after the comparison and is never part of it. The training weeks added are zero and each training week is valued at the weekly benefit amount, so the training addition is zero.
5. **Maximum benefit amount.** The rounded lesser amount plus the training addition; zero where the wage-weeks test is not met.

The weekly benefit amount and dependency allowance used are those on the parent claim.

## Worked example (hypothetical parent claim)

Parent weekly benefit amount 346.00, dependency allowance 15.00, base-period wages 30000.00; payments issued on the parent total 9300.00, of which 300.00 were cancelled.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Wage-weeks test: 40 times 346.00 | 13840.00, met by 30000.00 |
| Parent entitlement measure: 9300.00 less 300.00 | 9000.00 |
| One half of the measure | 4500.00 |
| 13 times (346.00 plus 15.00) | 4693.00 |
| Lesser amount, rounded down | 4500.00 |
| Training addition: zero training weeks | 0.00 |
| Maximum benefit amount | 4500.00 |

Had the parent's base-period wages been 13000.00, short of 13840.00, the maximum benefit amount would be zero.
